scripts.test:skill-growth: npm run build -- --outDir .skill-growth-local/production && playwright test --config tools/playwright-skill-growth.config.ts
scripts.test:combat-slice: vitest run tests/combat-slice.test.ts tests/combat.test.ts tests/combat-feel.test.ts tests/recovery-cancel.test.ts tests/parry-ranged.test.ts tests/enemy-combat-v1.test.ts tests/sword-wind.test.ts && playwright test --config tools/playwright-combat-slice.config.ts
scripts.test:wind-chimes: npm run build -- --outDir .wind-chimes-local/production && playwright test --config tools/playwright-wind-chimes.config.ts
scripts.test:sword-wind: playwright test tests/sword-wind.spec.ts tests/sword-wind-focus.spec.ts tests/sword-wind-rise.spec.ts --config tools/playwright-sword-wind.config.ts --grep 'WIND-0[1-6]|WIND-0[89]|WIND-1[012]'
scripts.test:sword-wind:off: VITE_DEV_GRANT_SWORD_WIND=0 playwright test tests/sword-wind.spec.ts tests/sword-wind-focus.spec.ts --config tools/playwright-sword-wind.config.ts --grep 'WIND-02|WIND-07|WIND-08'
scripts.test:village-integration: vitest run tests/village-integration.test.ts && playwright test tests/village-integration.spec.ts tests/economy-production.spec.ts --config tools/playwright-village-integration.config.ts
scripts.test:npc-life: vitest run tests/npc-life.test.ts tests/npc-life-combat.test.ts tests/npc-life-facility.test.ts tests/npc-navigation.test.ts tests/npc-speech.test.ts tests/npc-social.test.ts tests/npc-art.test.ts && playwright test tests/npc-life.spec.ts tests/npc-life-social-art.spec.ts tests/npc-life-combat.spec.ts tests/npc-life-facility.spec.ts --config tools/playwright-npc-life.config.ts
scripts.test:parry-feedback: vitest run tests/parry-feedback-v3.test.ts && playwright test tests/parry-feedback-v3.spec.ts --config tools/playwright-parry-feedback-v3.config.ts
scripts.test:defense-safety: vitest run tests/safety-defense.test.ts && playwright test --config tools/playwright-safety.config.ts
scripts.test:player-hurt: vitest run tests/player-hurt.test.ts && playwright test --config tools/playwright-player-hurt.config.ts
scripts.test:xiaobao: vitest run tests/xiaobao-combat.test.ts tests/xiaobao-navigation.test.ts tests/xiaobao.test.ts && playwright test --config tools/playwright-xiaobao.config.ts
